from numpy.random cimport bitgen_t

cdef inline uint64_t _gen_mask(uint64_t max_val) noexcept nogil:
    """Mask generator for use in bounded random numbers"""
    # Smallest bit mask >= max
    cdef uint64_t mask = max_val
    mask |= mask >> 1
    mask |= mask >> 2
    mask |= mask >> 4
    mask |= mask >> 8
    mask |= mask >> 16
    mask |= mask >> 32
    return mask
